Workers process queued jobs. Failed jobs return to the queue, which prevents temporary worker failures from causing jobs to be lost. The configuration setting is `retry_limit=3`.

Ten volunteers used the tool for one week, and six reported finding it useful. The pilot did not measure error rates or include a comparison with a control group. [Pilot report][pilot]
